book.pysift.guide.page1: Welcome to The Sift. The violet pools are Spirit Liquid: touching it drains your health and gives Soul Deprivation. Cure it with a Soul Antidote (crafting table).
book.pysift.guide.page2: Siftite Ore hides underground (y -40 to 40). Smelt Raw Siftite into ingots for Siftite gear: the full set halves the health drained by Spirit Liquid.
book.pysift.guide.page3: Charoite grows in the Violet Slate Abyss and in soul geodes deep below. It is used for compasses, homeward stones, sigils and Soulite.
book.pysift.guide.page4: Three bosses guard their arenas: the Harmonizer (Willow Grove), the Monarch (Amber Dunes) and the Sculk Monstrosity (Violet Slate Abyss). Each drops a core and a shard.
book.pysift.guide.page5: Want a rematch? Craft a Summoning Sigil, place a Sift Altar near an arena and use the sigil on it. The boss returns if it is not already alive.
book.pysift.guide.page6: Cores become weapons: Sonic Staff, Dash Charm and Sculk Hammer. At a smithing table, a boss shard awakens a weapon and makes it stronger.
book.pysift.guide.page7: Inlay a Sift Beacon gem into a chestplate at the smithing table. While worn, players within 8 blocks are immune to Soul Deprivation.
book.pysift.guide.page8: Soulite is stronger than netherite. Forge a Soulite Ingot, then upgrade netherite gear with the Soulite Upgrade template (dropped by bosses and found in ruins).
book.pysift.guide.page9: Each Soulite piece carries a boss ability, and the full set makes you immune to Soul Deprivation. Soulite boots let you walk on Spirit Liquid.
book.pysift.guide.page10: Lost? The Soul Compass points to arenas and ruins (sneak + use to switch). Hold a Homeward Stone for 3 seconds to return to your overworld spawn.

book.pysift.guide.page12: The eight jukeboxes at the Ancient City are the key: break one and that portal closes. Each one's faint beam shows the disc it wants; play them out of order and the portal tears, as it did for the ancients. To open a portal from here, build a closed frame of Soul Crystal blocks and use an Echo Shard on it.

book.pysift.sift_codex.name: The Sift Codex
book.pysift.sift_codex.tooltip: Notes on The Sift, its creatures and the song that broke the door
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.name: The Way In
Beneath the Deep Dark lies a door that was sealed long ago. This codex collects what is known of the world behind it: **The Sift**.

Entries open as you go. Meet a creature and its page fills in; pick up an [#](8a3a5e)ancient page[#]() and a piece of the old story returns.
- [Getting there](entry://journey/ritual): the eight-disc ritual
- [The Sift](entry://sift/spirit_liquid): spirit liquid and the land
- [Bestiary](entry://bestiary/guide): who lives there
- [Guardians](entry://bosses/guide): three bosses and their artifacts
- [Ancient pages](entry://lore/guide): what really happened
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.singer.p0:
Find the great frame of **reinforced deepslate** in an Ancient City. Within 16 blocks of it, blow a **goat horn**: a **Singer** claws its way out of the ground in front of you and stays there, listening.

Singers have no eyes. They talk, and keep their world together, by singing.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.singer.p1: Hold an echo shard and use it on the Singer to begin.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.ritual.p0:
The Singer calls two **Echo Golems**, who set eight **Resonant Jukeboxes** in a row before the frame. Each jukebox shows a faint beam in the colour of the disc it wants.

Fill them from left to right, in rainbow order:
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.ritual.p1:
1. [#](e0413a)Pigstep[#]() - bastions
2. [#](f08a2a)Relic[#]() - trail ruins
3. [#](c9a800)Precipice[#]() - trial chambers
4. [#](4f9a1f)Creator[#]() - ominous vaults
5. [#](3d8bff)5[#]() - ancient cities
6. [#](4b3fc0)Otherside[#]() - strongholds
7. [#](a050e0)13[#]() - dungeons
8. [#](d0559c)Tears[#]() - ghasts
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.ritual.p2:
When all eight are in, the jukeboxes play the scale one by one and the Singer sings along. The beams meet in the frame and the door to The Sift opens.

The jukeboxes are the key: break any one and the door closes again.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.discord.p:
A disc fits in any jukebox. Put one in the wrong place and that note plays flat.

The door **tears**. It flickers, dark sculk bursts out across the floor, and the Singer sings the melody *backwards* to force it shut. The discs are thrown out and you must start again.
*This is not the first time it has happened.*
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.arrival.p:
You arrive on a Sift portal of the biome you land in. The violet pools are **spirit liquid**: touching it drains your health and leaves you with **Soul Deprivation**.

Craft a **Soul Antidote** before you go.
There are no Ancient Cities in The Sift. To open a door back, build a closed frame of **Soul Crystal Blocks** and use an **echo shard** on it.

Or hold a **Homeward Stone** for 3 seconds to return to your overworld spawn.
In The Sift the needle points at the current target: one of the three boss arenas, or the nearest ruins. Sneak and use it to switch.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.name: The Sift
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.spirit_liqui:
Where spirit liquid flows, everything is alive and singing. It keeps the sculk red and the Singers furred.

Our bodies cannot take that many souls: it **drains your health** and causes **Soul Deprivation**. A full set of Siftite armour halves the drain.
Drink it to cure Soul Deprivation.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.red_sculk.p0:
Sculk is **native to The Sift**. Healthy sculk is red and glows, and it listens, because everything here talks by sound. It grows on the ground around the spirit pools.

The blue sculk of the Deep Dark is the same thing, **starved and rotting**.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rifts.name: Wild Rifts
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rifts.p0.tex: Small rift portals stand alone in the wild. Around every one of them the red sculk has turned **blue**: close to the rift it is all blue, further out red and blue mix, and at the edge only red remains.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rifts.p1.tex:
Air from the overworld has no souls in it. It pours in through the rifts, and the sculk it touches starves.

*The Sift is not spreading into our world. Our world is spreading into it.*
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.willow_grove: Soft violet meadows under soul willows. Blubs, Nuzzles, Slabbers and Pollinators graze here; watch the ground for Bloombuds. The **Harmonizer** guards its arena in the grove.
Hot amber sand, bleached sandstone and buried tombs. Scavengers hunt the wounded, Hurlers throw rocks, Trappers lay snares. The **Monarch** rules here.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.violet_slate: Dark slate under a violet crust, with Soul Crystal and charoite growing from it. Echo Golems gather crystals for the Singers. The **Sculk Monstrosity** waits at its heart.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.crimson_stra: Deep canyons cut through red layered rock, stepping down to rivers of spirit liquid. Dartbacks and Fuseflies make it dangerous.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.lullaby_hill: Rolling hills of crimson vein stone, where the Echo Golems wander and the Singers sing at night.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.soul_caldera: A scorched plateau of ember basalt and ash, with round soul volcanoes whose craters hold flat lakes of spirit liquid. Patina ore grows in the rift walls.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.red_zone_cav: Caves of void stone deep below everything else. Stalkers hide in the dark here.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.name: Bestiary
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.guide.p0:
Each creature of The Sift has a page. Locked pages show only a shadow: **meet the creature** (fight it, get hit by it, or use something on it) and its page fills in.

You can turn the model on each page by dragging it.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.blub.loc: Meet this creature to fill in its page
The Sift's friendliest creature, in five variants by biome. Feed it a **Soul Crystal Block** to tame it (1 in 3). A tamed Blub fights beside you and carries dropped items back to your inventory.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.nuzzle.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.nuzzle.p: A gentle creature that walks up to rub its face against you, giving Regeneration and Glowing. If you hit it, it shrieks and runs.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
The Sift's cattle, with a patch of soil on its back. Plant a flower there, let it grow, and shear it for more flowers. Breeds on Soul Crystal Blocks.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.pollinat: Meet this creature to fill in its page
Walks from plant to plant and bone-meals crops and saplings. Hit one and every Pollinator nearby stings back with poison.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.roamroot: Meet this creature to fill in its page
A slow, peaceful plant giant. Leave it alone: provoked, it stomps the ground and throws you into the air.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.bloombud: Meet this creature to fill in its page
Looks like a closed flower bud and never moves. Step within two blocks and it snaps shut on you, holding you in place.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.singer.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.singer.p: The people of The Sift: eyeless, furred, and always singing. Blow a goat horn near one and it answers with a song that grants Resistance. Singers keep The Sift together with their voices.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.echo_gol: Meet this creature to fill in its page

A neutral worker that gathers souls from soul sand and absorbs Soul Crystal Blocks, carrying one on its head for the Singers. Sign a pact with an echo shard and it brings you soul soil, soul sand and sometimes echo shards.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.sentinel: Meet this creature to fill in its page
A crested ruin warrior with a heavy blade. Its charged cleave hits hard enough to **shatter a raised shield**.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
Invisible in the dark. It circles behind you; its first strike from behind does double damage. Bring light.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.tuner.lo: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.tuner.p1: Never attacks, keeps its distance, and fills nearby monsters with Speed and Strength. Kill it first.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.hunter.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.hunter.p: One of the Monarch's soldiers. Throws soul javelins from range and **marks** you, so every Sift monster nearby comes for you.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.dartback: Meet this creature to fill in its page
A shelled shooter that fires spines from its back and charges in a straight line. Sidestep the charge, and hit it from the front: its shell halves damage from behind.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
A flying pest that swells and **explodes** a moment after it dies. The warning ring shows the blast radius: kill it from a distance.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
A spiny creature that reflects part of every melee hit and fires a ring of spines. Use a bow.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.nester.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.nester.p: A heavy brood-mother that keeps calling Seedlings and Sprouts. When it dies its young go berserk.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.seedling: Meet this creature to fill in its page
A swarm hatchling. Alone it is weak; in numbers it is not.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.sprout.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.sprout.p: Another swarm hatchling, often called in by a Nester.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.scavenge: Meet this creature to fill in its page
A carrion hunter that goes for whoever is below half health. Its bite makes you bleed until it dies.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.hurler.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.hurler.p: Tears rocks out of the ground and throws them from afar. Close the distance.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.wobble.l: Meet this creature to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.wobble.p: A wobbly, silly creature that leaves a cloud of nausea behind when it dies.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
Another of the Monarch's servants. It throws nets and buries soul snares on the path you are about to take.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
A tiny, very fast treasure goblin that flees on sight. Catch it for ores and rare Sift materials.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.name: Guardians
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.guide.name: The Three Guardians
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.guide.p0.t:
Three great creatures guard arenas in The Sift. The **Soul Compass** points to them. Each drops a **core**, used to make a weapon, and a **shard**, used to awaken it.

At half health every guardian grows stronger and calls help. Away from a fight, they heal and stay at their arena.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.guide.p1.t: Rematch: place an altar near an arena and use a sigil on it.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.harmonizer: Find this guardian to fill in its page
A jellyfish-like giant that keeps its distance. A cone of sound in front, a ring of sound that expands outward (jump it or stay inside it), and a slam if you get too close. It calls Fuseflies.
**Sonic Staff**: poke enemies from further away; hold use to chant and fire a sonic beam.
Awaken it with the boss's shard at a smithing table.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.monarch.lo: Find this guardian to fill in its page
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.monarch.p1: A caped king who fights up close: a two-hit combo, a leaping slam, a ground shockwave you can sidestep, and a spinning dash that leaves feathers which fire at you later. Its melee heals it.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.monarch.p2: **Dash Charm**: thrust both hands forward and dash.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.monarch.p3: Awaken it with the boss's shard at a smithing table.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.sculk_mons: Find this guardian to fill in its page
The deepest-rotted mass of sculk in The Sift. It swipes, slams, throws sculk cubes that roll after you, and grows sculk catalysts that **explode and heal it** unless you break them in time.
**Sculk Hammer**: alternate left and right swings; charge it to raise biting sculk maws from the ground.
Awaken it with the boss's shard at a smithing table.
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.name: Craft
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.siftite.name: Siftite
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.siftite.p0.t: Siftite ore hides underground in The Sift (y -40 to 40). Smelt raw siftite into ingots. A full set of Siftite armour **halves the health spirit liquid drains**.
Grows in the Violet Slate Abyss and in soul geodes deep below. Used for the Soul Compass, Homeward Stones, Summoning Sigils and Soulite.
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.patina.name: Patina
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.patina.p0.te: Patina ore grows in the rift walls of the Soul Caldera, weathered green near the surface. Its gears build every soul machine (see **Soul Power**).
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.beacon.name: Sift Beacon
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.beacon.p0.te: Inlay a Sift Beacon gem into a chestplate at a smithing table. While worn, every player within 8 blocks is immune to Soul Deprivation.
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.soulite.name: Soulite
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.soulite.p0.t:
Stronger than netherite. Forge a Soulite Ingot, then upgrade netherite gear with the Soulite Upgrade template (dropped by guardians, found in ruins).

Each piece carries a guardian's power; the full set makes you immune to Soul Deprivation, and the boots walk on spirit liquid.
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.essence.name: Soul Essence
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.essence.p0.t: Use Soul Essence on a block to cycle its shape (sneak and use to choose which property). Each change costs one essence.
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.brewing.name: Brewing
book.pysift.sift_codex.gear.brewing.p0.t: Soul Berries grow beside spirit liquid; Gloomcaps glow in caves. Brew them into Awkward Potions for **Soul Ward** and **Echo Sight**.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.name: Ancient Pages
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.guide.name: Ancient Pages
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.guide.p0.tex:
Eight pages survive. The first four were written by the people of the Ancient City; the rest come from The Sift itself.

Pick a page up and its entry opens here. Use a page in your hand to read it. Find all eight to see the whole story.

A ninth page, a Singers' song, is kept in the vault of an Echo Den.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.title: Sift Codex updated
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_1.name: I. We Heard Singing
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_1.p0.te: We dug down past the dark stone and found a wall that hummed. Put an ear to it and you hear singing - not one voice, a thousand, all in tune. Something lives behind the wall, and it is *happy*.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_1.p1.te: The elders say the wall is a door, and doors can be opened. We have begun the frame.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_2.name: II. The Eight Notes
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_2.p0.te:
The door answers to sound. We have learned its song: eight notes, played by eight boxes, in this order:

**1 3 7 6 5 2 4 8**

Each box wants its own disc. Each disc is a colour. Do not mix them up.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_3.name: III. A Wrong Note
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_3.p0.te: Someone swapped the third disc. The song came out as **1 3 4 6 5 2 4 8**, and the door did not open - it *tore*.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_3.p1.te: Red things poured through, glowing, singing. One of the singers was swept in with them. Then the red things touched our air, and began to turn blue, and began to scream.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.page_4: Ancient Page: The Frame of Bones
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_4.name: IV. The Frame of Bones
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_4.p0.te:
The singer closed the door. It sang our song *backwards* until the tear sealed. We are few now.

We have reinforced the frame with the only thing we have left in plenty: **our dead**. Let no one dig it out.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_4.p1.te: The big blue thing that was once furred will not stop howling. Any sound sends it into a rage. We think it is guarding the door now. We think it is starving.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.page_5: Ancient Page: Song of the Sieve
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_5.name: V. Song of the Sieve
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_5.p0.te:
*(Translated from a Singer's song.)*

The liquid is our blood, the liquid is our breath. Where it flows we are warm, where it flows the red ones listen and the hills hum back.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_5.p1.te: We sing so the sieve holds. We sing so souls pass through and do not fall.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.page_6: Ancient Page: The One Who Went Away
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_6.name: VI. The One Who Went Away
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_6.p0.te:
*(A Singer's lament.)*

One of us went through the torn door and did not come home. It sang the door shut from the other side. There is no liquid there. Its fur will fall. Its song will turn to weeping.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_6.p1.te: If you meet a **mourner**, it is ours. Bring it home.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.page_7: Ancient Page: Where the Rot Gets In
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_7.name: VII. Where the Rot Gets In
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_7.p0.te: The tear never closed all the way. Small rifts remain, and through them comes *their* air - air with no souls in it. The red ones near a rift go hungry, then blue, then quiet.
book.pysift.sift_codex.toast.page_8: Ancient Page: The Heart of the Rot
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_8.name: VIII. The Heart of the Rot
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_8.p0.te: All the rot that came through the rifts gathered in one place, deep in the abyss, and grew into something huge. It is not one of us any more. It is the hunger itself.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_8.p1.te: Cut out the heart and the rot will stop spreading. Then, perhaps, the howling ones beyond the door can be fed, and made warm, and brought home.
Sculk did not invade our world. **Our world infected The Sift.**

The ancients opened a door to a living world by song, and played one note wrong. Red, singing sculk and a Singer were swept through. Without spirit liquid they starved: the sculk rotted blue, and the Singer became a weeping **Mourner**.

The **Warden** is a starved creature of The Sift, kin to the Singers, kept alive only by the souls it swallowed. It rages at sound because sound is what opens the door.

The rifts still leak our soulless air into The Sift, and the rot gathered into the **Sculk Monstrosity**. Stop the rot - and then, perhaps, bring them home.
book.pysift.ancient_page_1.page1: We dug down past the dark stone and found a wall that hummed. Put an ear to it and you hear singing - not one voice, a thousand, all in tune. Something lives behind the wall, and it is happy.
book.pysift.ancient_page_1.page2: The elders say the wall is a door, and doors can be opened. We have begun the frame.
book.pysift.ancient_page_2.page1:
The door answers to sound. We have learned its song: eight notes, played by eight boxes, in this order:

1 3 7 6 5 2 4 8

Each box wants its own disc. Each disc is a colour. Do not mix them up.
book.pysift.ancient_page_3.page1: Someone swapped the third disc. The song came out as 1 3 4 6 5 2 4 8, and the door did not open - it tore.
book.pysift.ancient_page_3.page2: Red things poured through, glowing, singing. One of the singers was swept in with them. Then the red things touched our air, and began to turn blue, and began to scream.
book.pysift.ancient_page_4.page1:
The singer closed the door. It sang our song backwards until the tear sealed. We are few now.

We have reinforced the frame with the only thing we have left in plenty: our dead. Let no one dig it out.
book.pysift.ancient_page_4.page2: The big blue thing that was once furred will not stop howling. Any sound sends it into a rage. We think it is guarding the door now. We think it is starving.

book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.kin.name: Kin
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.kin.locke: Bring a Singer to a Warden
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.kin.p0.te:
Bring a Singer near a **Warden** and it trembles. Then it turns to the Warden and sings the eight notes **backwards**, slowly - the song that once shut the door.

The Warden falls quiet: for half a minute it forgets its anger and will not hunt anyone.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.hollowing:
Our world has no souls in its air. A Singer that stays in the Overworld starves: after about **five minutes** away from Soul Crystal Blocks and spirit liquid its fur falls out and it becomes a **Mourner**.

Keep a Soul Crystal Block or some spirit liquid within six blocks and it will hold on.

Mourners also wander the **Deep Dark**, weeping the backwards song and dimming the light around them.

Let a Mourner soak in **spirit liquid** for ten seconds and its fur grows back: it is a Singer again.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.homecomin: The Warden was one of them

Soak a **Warden** in spirit liquid long enough - or lead it into The Sift itself - and its fur grows back. It becomes a **Sift Warden**: calm, furred, and no longer starving.

Feed it an echo shard and it will follow you.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rot.name: The Rot Spreads
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rot.p0.title: It is still spreading
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rot.p0.text:
Red sculk near a rift slowly turns blue, one block at a time. The rot is fed by the deepest knot of it: the **Sculk Monstrosity**.

Defeat it, and the rot around the rifts in this world stops - and begins, very slowly, to turn red again.
Meet this creature to fill in its page
A Singer that starved in our world: bald, blue with rot, weeping the eight notes backwards. It never attacks, but its song brings darkness. Soak it in spirit liquid to bring the Singer back.
message.pysift.rot.stilled: The heart of the rot is gone. Around the rifts, the sculk begins to turn red again.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bestiary.sift_war: Meet this creature to fill in its page

A Warden that came home. Give it one echo shard and it is yours: it stays close to you, appearing at your side when you get far away. Right-click it to make it sit and wait, again to call it; sculk heals it. It **hears** monsters through walls and makes them glow but never hunts them; it **guards** you only when a monster hits you or you hit one. It keeps wild Wardens **calm**, and the blue sculk it walks over turns **red** again.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.name: Pottery Sherds
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.descr: Found in Ancient City and Sift ruin chests
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.p0.te:
Four sherds from Ancient Cities and Sift ruins: the **gate**, the **Singer**, its **kin** the Warden, and the **octave**. Like any sherd they can be crafted into a decorated pot.

Look closely at the octave: the height of each of its eight bars is the right order of the discs.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.p3.te: Its kin, left behind as a guard.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.p4.te: Use it: it plays the eight jukeboxes left to right and names each disc.

message.pysift.homecoming.missing_warden: The door listens... but no Sift Warden is here to go home.
message.pysift.homecoming.begin: The Singer turns to the door and sings the eight notes the right way round.
message.pysift.homecoming.done: The door remembers its song. The Singer and the Sift Warden go home, and the sculk here wakes up red.
message.pysift.homecoming.reunion: Somewhere close, you hear a familiar hum.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.mourning_: The song, for your own breath

A goat horn carved with the octave and the kin. Blow it and it plays the eight notes **backwards**: every Warden within 24 blocks falls quiet for 30 seconds, and Mourners stop weeping. One minute to recover between songs.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.censer.p0: A lantern burning spirit liquid that hums the lullaby. Singers within **16** blocks never hollow, and Mourners within **8** slowly grow their fur back - about a minute - with no need to be soaked.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.finale.lo: Still the rot, then go back to the door with a Singer and a Sift Warden
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.finale.p0:
When the rot is stilled, bring a **Singer** and a **Sift Warden** to the reinforced door of an Ancient City and blow the **Mourning Horn** there.

The Singer sings the eight notes the right way round - the song the ancients got wrong.
book.pysift.sift_codex.journey.finale.p1: The door remembers. The two of them go home, the sculk of the city wakes up red, and somewhere in The Sift they are waiting for you.
book.pysift.sift_codex.sift.rift_seal.p0:
Use a **Rift Seal** on a portal in The Sift: the rift closes, the rot within twelve blocks stops at once and slowly turns red again - even while the Sculk Monstrosity still lives.

Every door you open here is a rift, too.
book.pysift.sift_codex.bosses.sift_heart:
Drop the **Sculk Monstrosity's heart** into spirit liquid and wait: it is purified into a **Sift Heart**.

Use it on a **Warden** and it becomes a Sift Warden at once; use it on a **Mourner** and the Singer comes back.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.sherds.p5.te: **Octave + Kin** and a goat horn: the Mourning Horn. **Gate** and soul crystals: the Rift Seal. **Singer** and a soul lantern: the Lullaby Censer.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.chronicle.p0: Bind the eight ancient pages with a book: the whole account in one volume, in order.
message.pysift.den_guard.roused: The den's guards wake to a stranger's noise
Deep under every part of The Sift lie the Echo Dens: round halls where the **Singers** gather to sing the eight notes and keep the sieve in tune. Look at the candles in a resonance room: they burn in the order of the ritual discs.
In the grottoes their song rings in **Echo Cradles** until it grows a body: a new Echo Golem. Feed a cradle an echo shard to help it along.
Healthy, furred Wardens - **Sift Wardens** - keep the doors and the vault. They ignore you while the Singers sing, but strike a Singer or a golem, open the chests, or break the crystals and cradles, and they wake and give chase. Their anger fades, faster while a Singer is singing nearby. An awake guard will not take an echo shard.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_9.name: IX. The Choir Below
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_9.descr: Found in the Echo Den's vault
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_9.locke: Found in the Echo Den's vault
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_9.p0.te:
*(Sung in the Echo Den.)*

Come down, little ones, and learn the song. Eight notes, eight boxes, the colours in a row: **red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, pink**. Sing it so and the sieve stays in tune.
book.pysift.sift_codex.lore.page_9.p1.te: Our song rings in the crystals until the echo grows a body: so the golems are born, and they follow us. Our furred kin keep the door; while we sing they sleep. Wake them with a stranger's noise and they will not.
book.pysift.ancient_page_9.page1:
(Sung in the Echo Den.)

Come down, little ones, and learn the song. Eight notes, eight boxes, the colours in a row: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, pink. Sing it so and the sieve stays in tune.
book.pysift.ancient_page_9.page2: Our song rings in the crystals until the echo grows a body: so the golems are born, and they follow us. Our furred kin keep the door; while we sing they sleep. Wake them with a stranger's noise and they will not.
Every minute or so, while someone is listening, the lead Singer starts the octave the right way round and the choir joins in; any awake guard falls quiet at once. A **Mourning Horn** calms them too.

book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.name: Soul Power
book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.engine: Soul power is **rotation**, measured in soul pressure (SP). The Spirit Engine burns a bucket of spirit liquid (or soul essence, soul sand, soul soil) and turns at **32 RPM**, giving **256 SP**. Its flywheel spins on the right-hand side; shafts take the power from any side but the front.
book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.shafts:
Shafts carry rotation along their axis. Cogwheels side by side drive each other and **turn the other way**. A **large cogwheel** meshes with small ones on its diagonals: the small one turns **twice as fast**.

Faster machines work faster but cost more: a machine's load is its impact x RPM.
If two paths ask one block to turn at different speeds (or two engines disagree), the gears jam: the whole network stops and smokes until you fix it.
The needle swings from green to red as the load nears the capacity. Right-click it for the exact numbers; a comparator reads the load (0-15).

Past 100% the network is **overloaded**: everything stops, and after 5 seconds the machines tear the souls out of every creature nearby.
book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.grinde: Doubles ores, breaks cobblestone into gravel and sand, bones into bone meal, and sometimes leaves a soul essence. 64 SP at 32 RPM.
book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.sifter: Sifting the rot back to red

The craft of the ancients. While it turns, the sifter slowly turns **rotten blue sculk within 8 blocks back into red sculk**. Put sculk on its sieve to sift it red; gravel gives flint, sand gives clay, soul sand gives soul soil. 96 SP at 32 RPM; drive it from the crank side.
An emitter and a receiver with **the same resonant disc** link within 16 blocks. Wool and carpets block the wave. Loses 10%.
The emitter shoots a violet beam up to 32 blocks; **prisms** turn it (right-click to point them, sneak to go back). It passes glass and plants and links on the **front** of a receiver. Loses only 5%, but it must be aimed, and it burns whatever stands in it.
Two vein nodes within 16 blocks link when **every block between them is rock**. A cave cuts the vein. Loses 15%. While it runs, the rock along it grows into glowing soul-veined stone.
book.pysift.sift_codex.soul_power.pump.p:
Point the pump's nozzle at a spirit liquid pool and turn its crank: it drinks the source in front of it and sends the liquid down Spirit Pipes to your engines, which burn it when their fuel slot is empty.

A pipe left open at one end **leaks**, and the ground below it rots into soul soil.
